title: Workspace discovery root management
description: One explicit folder grant/revocation for bounded project discovery (`approve-root` / `forget-root`), the read-only listing of approved folders plus detected one-click candidates (`roots`), and the machine-wide opt-out (`decline`). Shapes are distinguished structurally by which of `root` / `roots`+`candidates` / `discovery` is present -- same precedent as projects.schema.json's oneOf, no explicit discriminant field. A candidate is only ever proposed, never approved automatically -- see claude-copilot's core/ecosystem/workspaces.py module docstring.

path.description: Only ever passed back to the CLI (e.g. as the next `forget-root --path`); never rendered. Null when the folder could not be resolved (`state: blocked`).

roots.description: `cc workspace roots --json`: every folder currently approved for project discovery.

path.description: Only ever passed back to the CLI; never rendered.

candidates.description: `cc workspace roots --json`: conventional folders under the home directory (e.g. ~/Developer, ~/Sites, ~/Projects, ~/code) that already contain at least one project and are not yet approved. Offered for one-click approval; never scanned or approved without the person's explicit choice.

path.description: Only ever passed back to the CLI as the next `approve-root --path`.

discovery.description: `cc workspace decline --json`: the machine-wide grant/decline state, same shape as the `workspaces --all` report's `discovery`.
